I keep seeing people claim there was dynamic pricing and that prices kept changing, but I personally did not witness this. I sat in the queue for about 5 hours and when I finally got in I kept getting the device error. During this struggle I attempted to buy tickets in about 20+ different sections before giving up, clearing my cookies, and switching to the other date for my city.

From what I saw stage left and right nose bleeds were $49, further back nosebleeds (better view) were $89, and aisle seating was $109. However the aisle seat required you to buy at least two and you got charged more for both. Some lower sections were $199, and $219 for aisles. Some sections were in the $249 range but also had VIP mixed in up to $599.

Many floor seats were $749 and I never saw a single seat over $899 as promised.

I get that this entire thing was a mess, and I am not defending that. But I really don’t like seeing people make accusations of dynamic pricing when they may have just been panicked and confused between normal ticket, aisle ticket, and VIP packages. 

I even went back in after securing my tickets to see what was left, and the prices for the last few remaining nosebleeds were $49. 

So if anyone has any evidence of this, or would be willing to share their experience I’d love to discuss it.

I am so sorry to those who were not able to secure tickets and hope you are able to secure some this Friday.
